item.title: HEP Five Ferris Wheel: The Red Wheel Over Umeda — Guide
item.description: The HEP Five Ferris wheel is one of Umeda’s most recognisable sights: a vivid red wheel that appears to grow straight out of the roof of the HEP Five shopping mall in the busy Umeda district. Riders board from the seventh floor and rise to 106 metres above street level, the enclosed gondolas giving a close, unusual view directly over the shops, stations and towers of northern Osaka rather than a distant panorama.

item.title: Tempozan Harbor Village: Ferris Wheel and Aquarium — Guide
item.description: Tempozan is Osaka’s waterfront leisure district, built around the bay at the mouth of the Aji river and easily reached from the city centre. Its two landmarks dominate: the Osaka Aquarium Kaiyukan, one of the largest aquariums in the world, whose central tank recreates the Pacific with whale sharks and rays; and the Tempozan Ferris Wheel, a 112-metre giant that was among the world’s tallest when built and glows in colour after dark.

item.title: Osaka Bay Guide: Kaiyukan, the Ferris Wheel & Sakurajima
item.description: West of the city centre, Osaka Bay opens the metropolis to the sea — a breezy waterfront of attractions, harbour views, and big-sky sunsets that makes a refreshing change from the neon canyons of Minami. Here you’ll find the giant Tempozan Ferris wheel, the superb Kaiyukan aquarium, sightseeing cruises, and, across the water on Sakurajima, Universal Studios Japan. It’s family territory and a great spot to watch the sun sink over the harbour.

item.title: Yokohama Cosmo World Guide: Ferris Wheel, Rides & Access
item.description: In the heart of Yokohama’s Minato Mirai waterfront, Cosmo World is a compact, colourful amusement park crowned by one of the city’s most recognisable landmarks — the Cosmo Clock 21 Ferris wheel. Once the world’s tallest, this 112-metre giant clock-and-wheel glows in shifting colours after dark and offers a slow, romantic ride over the bay, the skyline and the illuminated harbour. Around it spin roller coasters, a splashy water ride and family attractions.
